alignment_reasoning: Visual structure matches lionfish morphology (fins, stripes, body shape). However, the fine-grained classifier failed to identify it as a lionfish (top prediction: sea urchin), indicating weak class-defining features or confusion with radial symmetry. Coloration is structurally correct (stripes) but chromatically shifted (teal), which is acceptable for underwater scenes but reduces confidence in true-to-life generation.
artifact_reasoning: Router noted minor background smudging and tip blur. Topology audit reveals fragmented fin masks, suggesting subtle fusion or transparency rendering issues. No catastrophic structural failures (melting, extra limbs) observed. The primary artifact risk is the 'waxy' or over-smoothed texture of the water and background, typical of AI underwater scenes.
